title: 第3章 说好的金刚丹结果是召唤金刚啊第4章 传统丹药已经过时了听懂掌声
slug: 师弟你的丹药太不正经了
content_zh:
钟鸣九响，声传百里。
青云宗宗门大比，正式拉开帷幕。
数十座巨大的白玉擂台悬浮于云海之上，剑光纵横，符箓纷飞，五行灵力激荡不休。
李玄并没有上场的资格，也乐得清闲。
他站在丹鼎峰的观战区域，饶有兴致地看着擂台上的比斗，权当是了解这个修仙世界战斗方式的现场教学。
有的弟子御剑如龙，剑气森然；
有的弟子阵盘一展，困敌于方寸之间；
还有的弟子体魄强横，拳风呼啸。
很快，随着执事长老一声高喝：“下一场，主峰冷月涵，对阵，千刃峰赵乾！”
“宗门大比第一轮，最后一场的比赛，即将开始！”
全场的气氛瞬间被点燃。
宗门大比，一共三轮！
第一轮，相互抽签决定对手，先排除一半弟子。
冷月涵恰好抽取到了最后一个名额。
无数人翘首以盼，终于轮到他了！
“大师姐，终于轮到大师姐上场了！”
“哈哈，赵乾也算是千刃峰的天才了，练气九层，可惜他遇到了大师姐。”
“这还有悬念吗？我赌大师姐十招之内解决战斗！”
“大师姐必胜！”
“大师姐应援会为大师姐助阵！”

在万众瞩目之下，冷月涵一袭白裙，飘然落于擂台之上，依旧是那副清冷绝尘的模样。
她的对手，一个手持长刀的精悍青年赵乾，神色凝重地拱手道：“赵乾见过大师姐，请大师姐不吝赐教！”
他清楚，自己不可能胜过大师姐。
一场摧枯拉朽的战斗即将开始。
谁知，冷月涵却摆了摆手，清冷的声音传遍全场：“你先别急。”
赵乾一愣。
观众们也是一头雾水。
只见冷月涵在万千目光的注视下，不急不缓地从怀中取出了那个玉瓶，倒出一枚金灿灿的丹药。
丹药出瓶的瞬间，一股浓郁到几乎化为实质的药香瞬间席卷了擂台，甚至连周边的观战席都能闻到！
“好浓郁的丹香！”
观礼台上一位丹鼎峰的长老眼睛一亮，惊呼道：“这光泽，这丹韵，绝对是上品金刚丹！”
“不……甚至隐隐有触摸到极品门槛的迹象！”
此言一出，全场哗然。
“上品金刚丹？！还是接近极品的？！”
“莫非是丹鼎峰哪个筑基真人炼制的？”
赵乾的脸色更是瞬间黑了下来。
content_en:
The bell rings nine times and the sound spreads hundreds of miles.
The Qingyun Sect's sect competition officially kicked off.
Dozens of huge white jade arenas are suspended above the sea of ​​clouds. Swords are shining, talismans are flying, and the five elements of spiritual power are stirring endlessly.
Li Xuan was not qualified to play, so he was happy to relax.
He stood in the viewing area of ​​​​Danding Peak and watched the battle on the ring with great interest. He thought it was a live lesson to understand the fighting methods of this world of immortal cultivation.
Some disciples wield swords like dragons, and their sword energy is strong;
Some disciples spread out their formations and trapped the enemy within a few inches;
Some disciples are physically strong and their fists are roaring.
Soon, the elder deacon shouted: "In the next match, the main peak Leng Yuehan will face off against Zhao Qian from Thousand Blades Peak!"
"The first round of the sect competition and the final game is about to begin!"
The atmosphere of the whole place was instantly ignited.
The sect competition has three rounds in total!
In the first round, lots are drawn to determine the opponent, and half of the disciples are eliminated first.
Leng Yuehan happened to get the last spot.
Countless people had been waiting eagerly for it, and it was finally his turn!
"Senior Sister, it's finally Senior Sister's turn!"
"Haha, Zhao Qian can be considered a genius at Thousand Blades Peak. He is at the ninth level of Qi training. It's a pity that he met the senior sister."
"Is there any suspense here? I bet that Senior Sister will resolve the battle within ten moves!"
"Senior Sister must win!"
"The Senior Sister Support Club will help Senior Sister!"
Under the gaze of everyone, Leng Yuehan was dressed in a white dress and floated on the ring, still looking as cool as ever.
Her opponent, Zhao Qian, a capable young man holding a long sword, raised his hands solemnly and said: "Zhao Qian has met the senior sister, please give me some advice!"
He knew that he could not defeat his senior sister.
A devastating battle is about to begin.
Unexpectedly, Leng Yuehan waved his hand, and his cold voice spread throughout the audience: "Don't be anxious yet."
Zhao Qian was stunned.
The audience was also confused.
Under the gaze of thousands of eyes, Leng Yuehan took out the jade bottle from his arms and poured out a golden elixir.
The moment the elixir came out of the bottle, a scent that was so strong that it almost turned into substance swept across the arena and could even be smelled by the surrounding spectator seats!
"What a rich red fragrance!"
An elder from Alchemy Peak on the viewing platform's eyes lit up and he exclaimed: "This luster and charm are definitely top-grade Vajra Pills!"
"No... there are even faint signs of touching the threshold of the best!"
As soon as this statement came out, the whole place was in an uproar.
"High-quality diamond elixir?! Or something close to the best?!"
"Could it be that some foundation-building master from Danding Peak refined it?"
Zhao Qian's face darkened instantly.
